I'm advertising a summer studentship to build models of calcium signalling using logical network models. The position is paid and available for 8-12 weeks. Please forward onto anyone who might be interested!

 

If you have any queries, or would like more information, please contact me at bh...@mrc-cu.cam.ac.uk

 

Ben Hall

 

https://www.mrc-cu.cam.ac.uk/education/summer-students

 

Logical modelling of calcium networks

Calcium plays a number of important roles in the cell, determining how cells adhere to surfaces and one another, cell contractility, apoptosis and proliferation, in addition to cell specific behaviours such as nerve conduction. This is controlled both by calcium movement across the membrane, but also by the concentration of calcium in the ER. Recent studies have further suggested that calcium signalling may be linked to cancer progression for some tumour types.

In this project you would construct a logical model of calcium flow in the cell, and connect this to cellular phenotypes. This will be done both from the literature but also data collected by experimental collaborators at the MRC Cancer Unit. This project will involve mathematical modelling using locally developed tools and would be suitable for those with a wide range of scientific backgrounds and interests.
